page_title: MON 0-1 FRO | Monza v Frosinone 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Michael Fabbri is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' 3:4 – the corner kicks stats.
90+2' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Matias Soule is replaced by Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
88' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:5.
86' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Walid Cheddira will be replaced by Marvin Cuni (Frosinone).
86' Substitution. Reinier (Frosinone) in, Enzo Barrenechea out.
85' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul after Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) hacks down one of his opponents.
82' Valentin Carboni (Monza) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar.
80' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes the corner which is cleared.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Pedro Pereira (Monza) is replacing Samuele Birindelli.
77' Monza have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' The game is interrupted. Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
74' Monza hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) coming on for Abdou Harroui.
70' Corner kicks – 2:3.
68' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
68' Some neat passing and movement from Monza as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
66' Here is a change. Dany Mota is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Gianluca Caprari (Monza).
60' Frosinone keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
56' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Frosinone, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' Fouls committed – 7:7.
52' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Monza are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
47' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matias Soule (Frosinone) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Raffaele Palladino probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Armando Izzo (Monza). He is replaced by Danilo D'Ambrosio.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Warren Bondo (Monza) comes off for Valentin Carboni.
46' Raffaele Palladino has made a change at the break. Alessio Zerbin has come on in place of Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Alessandro Sorrentino.
39' Monza hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Pablo Mari (Monza) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.
33' The resulting set piece from Frosinone is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' The current number of corner kicks is 1:2.
29' The referee blows for a cooling break.
28' Warren Bondo (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
28' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Frosinone.
25' A pass into the box finds Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alessandro Sorrentino denies him.
22' Monza are seeing far more of the ball now.
20' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' The percentage of ball possession is – 73:27.
14' Warren Bondo (Monza) is penalised for holding. Michael Fabbri signals a set piece.
12' Monza keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
9' 0 - 1 What a finish that is! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) latches on to a brilliant cross and gets his head on the ball to put it inside the right post. No chance of stopping that.
8' Frosinone are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Frosinone comes to nothing.
5' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

3' Milan Djuric (Monza) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!

Monza will kick the game off.
